item.title: Wizards beat the Pacers 112-105, snapping a 3-game slide
item.description: Bub Carrington and Anthony Gill each scored 13 points and helped spark a decisive fourth-quarter run as the Washington Wizards outlasted the Indiana Pacers 112-105.

item.title: Johnson and McCollum power Hawks past the 76ers 117-107 as Atlanta snaps 3-game skid
item.description: Jalen Johnson had 32 points and 10 rebounds and CJ McCollum added 23 points as the Atlanta Hawks beat the Philadelphia 76ers 117-107 on Thursday night in the teams' first game after the All-Star break.

item.title: Mario Barrios defends WBC welterweight title against Ryan Garcia on Saturday
item.description: Mario Barrios defends his WBC welterweight title against Ryan Garcia on Saturday night.

item.title: TikTok stunt fail leads to pair of teens facing charges, the NYPD says
item.description: The charges follow the rescue of a Lynbrook 16-year-old who became trapped inside a pillar of the bridge on Monday.

item.title: Madina Okot, Joyce Edwards pace No. 3 South Carolina over No. 25 Alabama 76-57
item.description: Joyce Edwards had 23 points and 12 rebounds, Madina Okot scored 16 points and pulled in 16 rebounds, and No. 3 South Carolina beat No. 25 Alabama 76-57.

item.title: Raptors return from the All-Star break to beat the Bulls 110-101
item.description: Brandon Ingram scored 31 points and the Toronto Raptors returned from the All-Star break to beat the Chicago Bulls 110-101 on Thursday night.

item.title: Spurs beat the Suns 121-94 in Austin for their 7th straight win
item.description: Stephon Castle scored 20 points, Victor Wembanyama added 17 and the San Antonio Spurs beat the short-handed Phoenix Suns 121-94 on Thursday night for their seventh straight victory.

item.title: Fulwiley scores 26 as No. 7 LSU rallies to defeat No. 17 Mississippi 78-70
item.description: MiLaysia Fulwiley scored 26 points as No.7 LSU erased an 11-point deficit in the final eight minutes and beat No. 17 Mississippi 78-70.

item.title: Betts powers No. 2 UCLA past Washington 82-67 to clinch a share of the Big Ten title
item.description: No. 2 UCLA beat Washington 82-67 to clinch a share of the Big Ten women's regular-season title.

item.title: Thai police go undercover as lion dancers to nab a serial burglar
item.description: Thai police say they've caught an elusive serial burglar by going undercover as lion dancers at a temple fair.
